newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B share index end little changed.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B share index end little changed.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index closed almost unchanged on Tuesday on the last trading day of 1996 and brokers said last-minute selling of market giant Shanghai Chlor Alkali wiped out gains early in the session.
The index edged down 0.035 points or 0.05 percent to 67.026 points on volume of 17.3 million shares worth $7.7 million.

The market was in positive territory for most of the session, but in the last few minutes, an institution sold a large amount of shares in Chlor Alkali, which has a heavy weighting on the index, to another institution, pushing the index down, traders said.
Chlor Alkali was the biggest loser and the most active stock today, slipping $0.022 or 7.33 percent to $0.278, on volume of 3.1 million shares.
But Pudong shares performed strongly today with investors optimistic over the prospects of the Pudong New Area, traders said.

Real estate developer Lujiazui, ex-rights today, was the second biggest gainer and the second most active stock, helped by news that foreign banks with branches in Pudong had been granted approval to do local currency business.
It closed up $0.034 or 3.61 percent to $0.974, on volume of 2.0 million shares.
Another Pudong share, real estate developer Wai Gaoqiao also performed well on institutional position-building, gaining $0.012 or 2.53 percent to $0.486, on volume of 808,500 shares.
Of 42 B shares, 39 traded, with 15 down, 12 flat and 12 up.
"The market was dominated by a holiday mood," one broker said. "Most investors left the market, which made the index move in a very narrow range."
"The index will rise above the 68-point resistance level early next year after the consolidation of the past weeks," a second broker said.
Shanghai A shares fell on concerns about possible negative news around the year-end, and unwinding selling pushed the index down, brokers said.

The A index fell 18.484 points or 1.90 percent to 954.983 points on volume of 421.3 million shares worth 3.9 billion yuan. The SSE 30 blue-chip index ended down 25.262 points or 1.02 percent to 2442.427 points.
